none: PAS WILT-EE1C84: Probable Roman curse tablet
contea di ritrovamento: Somerset (Inghilterra e Galles)

Probable Roman lead curse tablet, fixed with an iron nail that does not penetrate through to the other side. It is 32.14mm wide, 30.13mm long, its thickness is 1.84mm and it weighs 121.17g. The head of the nail measures 10.42x9.75mm. In section the tablet is oval having been rolled over four and a half times.
